Frequently asked questions about Gastón Philippe
 Sample of 20 matches, from 14/03/2025 to 30/10/2026. Answers refer to the matches in the table and the selected filters.
 Card totals and percentages use yellow plus red cards in this sample.
 What is Gastón Philippe’s average number of cards per match?
 Gastón Philippe averages 5.65 yellow cards and 0.50 red cards per match across the 20 matches analysed: 6.15 cards per match in total.
 What are Gastón Philippe’s penalty statistics?
 Gastón Philippe has awarded 8 penalties in the 20 matches analysed, averaging 0.40 per match.
 How often does Gastón Philippe exceed 3.5, 4.5 and 5.5 cards?
 Across the 20 matches in the sample, the total exceeded 3.5 cards in 85.0% of matches, 4.5 in 70.0% and 5.5 in 70.0%.
 How much does Gastón Philippe’s card count vary between matches?
 Of the 20 matches analysed, 10.0% ended with 0–2 cards, 20.0% with 3–5 and 70.0% with 6 or more.
 How do Gastón Philippe’s latest ten matches compare within this sample?
 The ten most recent matches in the sample average 5.60 cards, compared with 6.15 across all 20 matches analysed.
 How does Gastón Philippe distribute yellow cards between home and away teams?
 Across the 20 matches analysed, home teams average 2.70 yellow cards and away teams 2.95. This describes the sample; it does not, on its own, establish favouritism.
